author: New China TV
description: During the current peak tuna season, fish markets across Libya's capital, Tripoli, are bustling as abundant supplies and affordable prices draw shoppers away from costlier meats and seafood.
title: Libya's peak tuna season revitalizes markets, sustains fisheries sector

author: New China TV
description: A Chinese research team has achieved a breakthrough with its newly developed RNA editing technology, named LEAPER, in the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), a severe and rare hereditary disease. #DMDtreatment #Chinesebreakthrough
title: Chinese researchers treat rare disease via new RNA editing technology

author: New China TV
description:
"I think that development is the basic premise or the foundation of human rights, which China is doing very well." 
The 2026 Forum on Global Human Rights Governance kicked off in Beijing on Thursday, focusing on joint development and shared human rights. Guests attending the forum agreed that as China advances modernization, it has consistently enhanced human rights protection and made historic progress in promoting human rights. #GLOBALink
title: Forum on Global Human Rights Governance opens in Beijing

author: New China TV
description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan on Wednesday accused Israel of threatening "peace and tranquility" in the region.
title: Turkish president says Israel threatens regional peace, tranquility

author: New China TV
description: The 22nd edition of Project Qatar, the country's largest construction materials, equipment, and technology exhibition, opened Tuesday at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center.
title: Project Qatar 2026 opens with participation of 145 companies

author: New China TV
description:
What do human rights look like in daily life in China?
In Tianjin, visitors from different countries found their answer through better working conditions, accessible cultural facilities, a greener environment, etc.
title: Human rights of China through the eyes of international visitors

author: New China TV
description: Zou Bo, a member of China's post-95 generation, left a stable job in the city to pursue a different dream. Seeing the vast potential of modern agriculture, he returned to his hometown five years ago to launch his own farming venture. Today, with the help of smart technologies and modern management, his team now oversees more than 5,000 mu (about 333 hectares) of farmland.
title: Post-95 entrepreneur fuels farming with modern methods in east China

author: New China TV
description: China launched Friday a new communication technology test satellite from the Wenchang Space Launch Site in Hainan aboard a Long March-5 rocket, which successfully placed the payload into its preset orbit. The satellite will be used for multi-band and high-speed communication technology validation tests, and the mission also marks the 650th flight of the Long March carrier rocket series.
title: China launches new communication technology test satellite

author: New China TV
description: Students at Northwest A&F University took part in wheat harvesting in experimental fields during the summer harvest season, bringing classroom learning into real agricultural practice. The university continues its long-standing tradition of field-based teaching, with all six generations of wheat variety upgrades in Shaanxi originating from seeds developed by its researchers.
title: From Lab to Field: Chinese University Students Harvest Wheat in Experimental Farms

author: New China TV
description: China and Kuwait on Tuesday marked the International Day for Dialogue among Civilizations with a cultural event promoting mutual learning, people-to-people exchanges, and intercultural understanding.
title: China, Kuwait hold cultural event focused on dialogue among civilizations

author: New China TV
description: Scientists have uncovered a vast "whale necropolis" nearly 7,000 meters deep in the southeastern Indian Ocean, home to the largest and deepest collection of whale remains ever found, including five active whale-fall ecosystems and hundreds of fossil sites spanning at least 5.3 million years.
title: 5.3-million-year-old whale graveyard hotspot found in Indian Ocean

author: New China TV
description: The 10th edition of the China-South Asia Expo is running from June 11 to 16 in Kunming, capital of southwest China's Yunnan Province. Sri Lankan delegation leader Charita Yattogoda expressed high expectations during an exclusive interview. #GLOBALink
title: China-South Asia Expo important platform for South-South trade cooperation: Sri Lankan official

author: New China TV
description: At the 2026 Forum on Global Human Rights Governance in Beijing, Iraq's former president recalled an old Arabic saying: Seek knowledge, even as far as China. For centuries, his culture has seen China as a source of wisdom and know-how.
title: A proverb that connects Iraq and China

author: New China TV
description: "This is not only a disaster for the Palestinian people, but a disaster for the population of the entire region," former Iraqi President Abdul Latif Rashid said in an exclusive interview with Xinhua, calling for respect for human rights, United Nations resolutions and the rule of law.
title: Former Iraqi President on Gaza Crisis: "This Is a Disaster for the Entire Region"

author: New China TV
description: Human rights can never be talked about while ignoring many people's sufferings in the world. Every child, doctor and resident of Gaza is entitled to basic human rights, said the former Iraqi president Abdul Latif Rashid while attending the 2026 Forum on Global Human Rights Governance in Beijing.
title: People from Gaza deserve basic human rights -- former Iraqi president

author: New China TV
description: The Second World Conference of Classics was held from June 9 to 10 in Athens, where participants called for stronger international academic cooperation and deeper dialogue among civilizations. Attendees highlighted the relevance of classical wisdom in addressing contemporary global challenges.
title: World Conference of Classics calls for deeper civilizational dialogue

author: New China TV
description: Two waterspouts were visible off the coast of Dongping Town, south China's Guangdong. The rare phenomenon lasted for about five minutes in the early evening of June 8. #Waterspout #China
title: Two waterspouts appear off south China coast

author: New China TV
description: The 10th China-South Asia Expo kicked off on Thursday in Kunming City, capital of southwest China's Yunnan Province. The event has put an emphasis on enhancing regional trade and industrial cooperation under the theme "Solidarity and Coordination for Common Development." #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 10th China-South Asia Expo opens in SW China to facilitate regional trade

author: New China TV
description: China on Thursday released a new national human rights action plan at the opening of the 2026 Forum on Global Human Rights Governance, aiming to ensure the principal position of the people is respected and the people's fundamental interests are safeguarded. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China releases national human rights action plan for 2026-2030

author: New China TV
description: In recent years, a growing number of Taiwan compatriots have taken advantage of preferential policies to start businesses on the Chinese mainland. Kuo Yi-Fan is one of them. Having run cafes for 10 years in Fuzhou, east China's Fujian, he has also made innovations in the industry. #GLOBALink
title: From Taiwan to Fujian: a coffee entrepreneur's journey of innovation

author: New China TV
description: Giant panda Ai Bao is a mom again. She gave birth to a healthy female cub on June 3 at Everland theme park in South Korea. The father is Le Bao. The pair arrived from China in 2016 -- and have since welcomed four cubs. #AiBao #panda #GiantPanda #PandaCub #BabyPanda #SouthKorea #Everland #KoreaPanda
title: Giant panda on loan from China gives birth to fourth cub in S. Korea

author: New China TV
description: "75 Years of Friendship: Seminar on China-Pakistan Joint Contribution to the Global Governance Initiative and the CPEC" was held on Tuesday in Islamabad, the capital of Pakistan.
title: Seminar on China-Pakistan joint contribution to GGI, CPEC held in Islamabad

author: New China TV
description: Iran's main military command, Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, announced early Thursday that the Strait of Hormuz has been closed to all vessels, including oil tankers and commercial ships, due to security threats in the waterway. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Iran's main military command announces full closure of Hormuz Strait
